saisdata: course data for the SAIS MIEF R workshop

Source: R/saisdata-package.R
saisdata-package.Rd

Six datasets, ready to use once you run library(saisdata):

Details

  • weo: the IMF's World Economic Outlook of October 2026, one row per country (or IMF group) and year, with twelve indicators as columns: growth, inflation, unemployment, the current account, GDP per person, population, and the government's revenue, spending, balances and debt.

  • weo_mini: twelve rows of weo that fit on one screen.

  • weo_full: all 44 of the IMF's indicators for every country, long.

  • weo_indicators: what each of those indicators measures, in plain words.

  • weo_groups: the same source for the IMF's two big country groups, laid out as the IMF publishes it, with the years across.

  • wb_groups: the World Bank's region, income level and lending type for 217 countries.

For Day 2, copy_course_files() copies a spreadsheet and eight saved series into your project, so you can practice importing files.

Type ?weo, or the name of any dataset after a question mark, to open its help page. vignette("saisdata") has a short worked example that runs offline.

The tables are a frozen snapshot. They do not change when the IMF or the World Bank publishes new numbers.

Backups

The package is the course's backup for every live call to the IMF or the World Bank: each lesson's numbers are saved here and need no internet. The package has a backup of its own. Every table is also a CSV file in the repository, so if saisdata will not install, readr::read_csv() reads a table straight from GitHub. The lines are in the README and in https://github.com/Teal-Insights/saisdata/tree/main/csv.

Credit

Print this line under every chart you make from these data:

Source: International Monetary Fund, World Economic Outlook Database, October 2026, https://data.imf.org/en/datasets/IMF.RES:WEO. Country groups: The World Bank: World Development Indicators: country and lending groups (CC BY 4.0). Net interest is the primary balance minus the overall balance, calculated for this workshop.

Drop the second sentence if your chart uses no World Bank groups, and the third if it shows no net interest.

Terms of use

The package's code and documentation are MIT licensed. That license does not cover the data. The data keep their own terms: the IMF's terms for statistical data for the five weo tables, and CC BY 4.0 with the World Bank's added terms for wb_groups. Each dataset's help page summarizes them. The full summary is in the file LICENSE-data.md, installed with the package; find it with system.file("LICENSE-data.md", package = "saisdata").

This package is not an official IMF or World Bank product.
